sources.entry: FolderForge - Customize macOS folders with colors, artwork, icons, reusable presets, and rule-based workspace styling.

summary.one_liner: FolderForge is an open-source macOS app for customizing folder icons with colors, gradients, images, symbols, and presets, including rule-based styling across folder trees.
summary.what_it_does: It applies custom designs to macOS folders using color and gradient fills, image fills with optional overlays, SF Symbols, emoji, text, and application icons as overlays. It supports full ICNS import and reusable presets, and can recursively import and style folder structures. A Finder Services integration lets users pick a style visually from a "My Styles" set or built-in presets via right-click. Smart Style matches folders by name, path, marker files, or file types, and shows proposed changes before applying them. It can restore original icons and undo the last batch, and it includes a command-line interface for applying, resetting, and dry-running styles.
use_cases: customize macOS folder icons with colors or images
apply the same folder style across a project tree
preview folder icon changes before applying
script folder styling from the command line
how_to_run: Alternatively, install FolderForge from the Mac App Store or download the notarized DMG from Releases
notable: Smart Style rules preview every change before anything is applied
Saves original icons before replacing them so they can be restored
Finder Services integration for choosing styles from a right-click menu
Command-line interface with dry-run, recursive, and exclude options
Works locally with no accounts, analytics, or network features
caveats: Smart Style scans default to one level deep and stop at 2,000 folders
